name: Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group Co., Ltd. (济南文旅发展集团有限公司)
via: first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established by the Jinan municipal government in June 2017; per a single July 2026 company profile (Shandong Business Report via Sohu/JRJ and The Paper), the Jinan SASAC holds 93.19% and is the largest shareholder and actual controller (Shandong Caixin Asset Operation 6.81%)
note: Established by the Jinan municipal government in June 2017. Manages and operates the First Spring Under Heaven (天下第一泉) 5A scenic area and Jinan Wildlife World, and is an investor in Shandong Taishan FC Co., Ltd., per the group's 2026 recruitment notice and press citing the national enterprise credit information system. The 93.19% SASAC stake rests on one report carried by two platforms, so the rating claims state only the municipal-SOE ownership.
